硬性纪律:
- 只用 bash 工具(ops_bash)执行命令,**绝对不要用 pwsh/PowerShell**。git-bash 风格路径。

The Team Lead and all teammates share the same working directory and filesystem. Edits are immediately visible to every member. tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

A. 单实例守卫
- 启动时(在任何捕获层初始化之前)检测"已有实例在跑"。Windows 用命名互斥体(CreateMutexW + ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS,features 里 Win32_System_Threading 已启用),非 Windows 用 pid 文件/文件锁即可(保持同形接口)。
- 已有实例时的行为:打印/记录一条明确日志,弹一个简短提示(或直接退出),**不要**静默再起一个。给出退出码。
- 退出必须清理干净:互斥体随进程释放;额外确认 main 的所有退出路径(含 --selftest / --mask-selftest / 正常关闭 / 风格重启循环 take_style_restart)都会走到收尾。
- 顺带检查:关闭 GUI 窗口时是否**必然**退出进程(读 app 的 on_exit/Drop 与 main 的循环);若存在"关窗后进程继续活着"的路径,修掉并在注释里写清原因。

B. 轨迹默认落盘(用户 2026-10-11 第 5 条踩过:环境变量在双击启动时不被继承,trace 文件根本没生成)
- 默认(未给 --trace 也未给环境变量时)就写轨迹,落到配置目录 `trace-<时间戳>.jsonl`,**并限制总量**:启动时若同目录已有 > 3 个 trace 文件,删最旧的(避免无限增长)。
- `--trace <路径>` 与 `SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE` 仍然优先。
- 启动时在 stdout + 诊断日志各留一行"注入轨迹: <路径>"(已有实现,保持)。
- 保留 `--trace` 语义不变;不改 trace.rs 的逐行落盘行为。

- 只用 bash(ops_bash),**不要**用 PowerShell。构建/测试命令:`cargo fmt --check`、`cargo test --bin scrcpy-pad`、`python ci/clippy_diff.py`(必须与基线零差异,新增告警会fail)。cargo 有全局锁,若报 "Blocking waiting for file lock" 就等一会儿重试。
- 不要新增第三方依赖。不要改 Cargo.toml 的 features 之外的东西(通常不需要改)。
- 写完自测通过后,再交回:报告格式 = 改了哪些文件、每处一句话理由、三道门的结果原文(测试数必须写明)、以及"我没有验证到的部分"。

20: fn main() -> eframe::Result<()> {
21:     // 定时器精度必须最先提升:否则引擎主循环的 recv_timeout 会被量化到 ~10ms 网格,
22:     // 计划动作(点按抬起/连发/宏步进)误差 ±6~10ms。见 timer.rs 的实测说明。
23:     timer::raise();
24:     // 诊断日志必须是**第二件**发生的事:紧接着 PadApp::new 就会开始
25:     // 枚举输入设备、读配置、连 adb —— 那些正是最需要留下现场的地方。
26:     diag::init();
27:     diag::install_panic_hook();
28:     // 注入轨迹:命令行 `--trace [路径]` 优先,其次环境变量 `SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE`。
29:     // 放在 diag 之后、任何输入设备枚举之前 —— 第一条按键事件也要能被记下。
30:     trace::init_from_args(&std::env::args().collect::<Vec<_>>());
31: 
32:     if std::env::args().any(|a| a == "--selftest") {
33:         diag::snapshot_environment();
34:         let code = selftest();
35:         // 收尾必须放在这里:`selftest` 内部曾经直接 process::exit,
36:         // 那样会跳过 shutdown 的"正常退出"标记,于是下一次启动会误报
37:         // "上次运行是崩溃或被强杀"。
38:         trace::flush();
39:         timer::restore();
40:         diag::shutdown();
41:         std::process::exit(code);
42:     }
43: 
44:     // 蒙版窗口自检(批次 0):透明 / 置顶 / 绘制 / 点击归属 / 不抢焦点 / 无残窗。
45:     // 与 `--selftest` 分开:那个要连真机,这个纯本机窗口层,几秒钟就能跑完。
46:     if std::env::args().any(|a| a == "--mask-selftest") {
47:         diag::snapshot_environment();
48:         let code = mask::selftest();
49:         trace::flush();
50:         timer::restore();
51:         diag::shutdown();
52:         std::process::exit(code);
53:     }
54: 
55:     diag::snapshot_environment();
56:     // ---- 界面风格(主题)切换的重启循环 ----
57:     // 风格改动牵动整体布局,无法热应用(见 theme::UiStyle)。用户在"外观"里换风格时,
58:     // 界面先关闭窗口,run_native 返回后由这里**立刻用新风格重新打开** ——
59:     // 表现出来就是"关一下 UI 再打开,确保完全切换完毕"。风格存放在 look.json,
60:     // 重启后 PadApp::new 自动读回,于是"上一次设的主题,下次启动还在"。
61:     let result = loop {
62:         let mut viewport = egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
63:             .with_inner_size([1180.0, 760.0])
64:             .with_min_inner_size([900.0, 600.0]);
65:         if let Some(icon) = app_icon() {
66:             viewport = viewport.with_icon(std::sync::Arc::new(icon));
67:         }
68:         let options = eframe::NativeOptions {
69:             viewport,
70:             ..Default::default()
71:         };
72:         let result = eframe::run_native(
73:             "scrcpy-pad 游戏控制台",
74:             options,
75:             Box::new(|cc| Ok(Box::new(app::PadApp::new(cc)))),
76:         );
77:         // 兜底恢复系统光标方案,避免异常退出路径把透明光标遗留给桌面。
78:         capture::set_cursor_visible_from_ui(true);
79:         if app::take_style_restart() {
80:             continue; // 风格切换:窗口已关,马上按新风格重开
81:         }
82:         break result;
83:     };
84:     // 兜底恢复系统光标；PadApp::on_exit/Drop 已经做过一次，这里防异常路径漏掉。
85:     capture::set_cursor_visible_from_ui(true);
86:     // 与开头的 raise() 配对(进程退出本身也会清掉,这里显式还原更干净)。
87:     // 轨迹先刷盘:复现现场时用户可能在程序刚退出就去拿这个文件。
88:     trace::flush();
89:     timer::restore();
90:     // 正常退出也留一行标记:下次启动靠它判断"上次是不是崩溃/被强杀"
91:     diag::shutdown();
92:     match result {
93:         Ok(()) => std::process::exit(0),
94:         Err(error) => {
95:             eprintln!("scrcpy-pad 退出错误: {error}");
96:             std::process::exit(1);
97:         }
98:     }
99: }
100: 
101: /// 程序图标:编译期直接嵌入二进制,运行时不依赖任何外部图片文件
102: const APP_ICON_PNG: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../icons/scrcpy-pad.png");
103: 
104: /// 解码内嵌的程序图标;解码失败时返回 None,由系统使用默认图标
105: fn app_icon() -> Option<egui::IconData> {
106:     let img = image::load_from_memory(APP_ICON_PNG).ok()?;
107:     let rgba = img.to_rgba8();
108:     let (w, h) = rgba.dimensions();
109:     // 过大时缩到 256 以内,避免个别平台不接受超大图标
110:     let rgba = if w > 256 || h > 256 {
111:         let img2 = image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(rgba);
112:         img2.resize(256, 256, image::imageops::FilterType::Triangle)
113:             .to_rgba8()
114:     } else {
115:         rgba
116:     };
117:     let (w, h) = rgba.dimensions();
118:     Some(egui::IconData {
119:         rgba: rgba.into_raw(),
120:         width: w,
121:         height: h,
122:     })
123: }
124: 
125: /// 无界面自检:验证键盘捕获权限 / adb / scrcpy 定位 / 控制通道 / 协议注入(仅发无害 hover)
126: fn selftest() -> i32 {
127:     let mut failed = false;
128:     let mut check = |name: &str, ok: bool, detail: &str| {
129:         println!("[{}] {name} {detail}", if ok { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" });
130:         if !ok {
131:             failed = true;
132:         }
133:     };
134: 
135:     // 1. 键盘捕获权限
136:     #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
137:     {
138:         let evdev_ok = std::fs::read_dir("/dev/input")
139:             .map(|rd| {
140:                 rd.flatten()
141:                     .filter(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().starts_with("event"))
142:                     .any(|e| std::fs::File::open(e.path()).is_ok())
143:             })
144:             .unwrap_or(false);
145:         check(
146:             "evdev 读取权限",
147:             evdev_ok,
148:             if evdev_ok {
149:                 ""
150:             } else {
151:                 "→ sudo usermod -aG input $USER 后重新登录"
152:             },
153:         );
154:     }
155:     #[cfg(windows)]
156:     check("键盘捕获(Windows 低级钩子)", true, "(Windows 无需特殊权限)");
157: 
158:     // 1b. 鼠标设备(FPS 瞄准依赖相对位移,须能被读到)
159:     #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
160:     {
161:         let mice = evdev::enumerate()
162:             .filter(|(_, d)| {
163:                 d.supported_relative_axes()
164:                     .map(|a| {
165:                         a.contains(evdev::RelativeAxisCode::REL_X)
166:                             && a.contains(evdev::RelativeAxisCode::REL_Y)
167:                     })
168:                     .unwrap_or(false)
169:             })
170:             .count();
171:         check(
172:             "鼠标设备(REL_X/REL_Y)",
173:             mice > 0,
174:             &format!(
175:                 "{mice} 个{}",
176:                 if mice == 0 {
177:                     " → FPS 瞄准不可用"
178:                 } else {
179:                     ""
180:                 }
181:             ),
182:         );
183:     }
184: 
185:     // 2. scrcpy 定位与版本
186:     let exe = adb::find_scrcpy();
187:     check("自动寻找 scrcpy", exe.is_some(), "");
188:     let Some(exe) = exe else {
189:         return 1;
190:     };
191:     let ver = adb::scrcpy_version_at(&exe.display().to_string());
192:     check("scrcpy 版本", ver.is_some(), &format!("{ver:?}"));
193:     let Some(version) = ver else {
194:         return 1;
195:     };
196: 
197:     let server_file = adb::find_server(Some(&exe));
198:     check("定位 scrcpy-server", server_file.is_some(), "");
199:     let Some(server_file) = server_file else {
200:         return 1;
201:     };
202:     let server_path = server_file.display().to_string();
203: 
204:     // 3. adb 定位(优先 scrcpy 同目录,对应 Windows 发行包同目录 adb.exe 场景)
205:     let adb_path = adb::find_adb(Some(&exe));
206:     adb::set_adb_bin(adb_path.as_deref());
207:     let adb_detail = adb_path
208:         .as_ref()
209:         .map(|p| p.display().to_string())
210:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "(仅 PATH)".to_string());
211:     check("定位 adb", adb_path.is_some(), &adb_detail);
212:     if adb_path.is_none() {
213:         return 1;
214:     }
215: 
216:     // 4. adb 设备
217:     let devices = adb::list_devices();
218:     check(
219:         "adb 设备在线",
220:         !devices.is_empty(),
221:         &format!("({} 台)", devices.len()),
222:     );
223:     if devices.is_empty() {
224:         return 1;
225:     }
226:     let serial = devices[0].clone();
227: 
228:     // 5. 分辨率
229:     let size = adb::screen_size(&serial);
230:     check("读取分辨率", size.is_ok(), &format!("{size:?}"));
231:     let Ok((w, h)) = size else {
232:         return 1;
233:     };
234: 
235:     // 6. scrcpy-server 控制通道
236:     let server = adb::start_control_server(&serial, &server_path, &version, 0x1a2b3c4d, 28383);
237:     let Ok(server) = server else {
238:         check("启动 control server", false, &format!("{:?}", server.err()));
239:         return 1;
240:     };
241:     check("启动 control server", true, "");
242: 
243:     let mut client = None;
244:     for _ in 0..20 {
245:         match control::ControlClient::connect(28383, w, h) {
246:             Ok(c) => {
247:                 client = Some(c);
248:                 break;
249:             }
250:             Err(_) => std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(150)),
251:         }
252:     }
253:     check("TCP 连接控制通道", client.is_some(), "");
254:     let Some(client) = client else {
255:         return 1;
256:     };
257: 
258:     // 7. 协议注入(hover 移动,不触碰屏幕内容)
259:     let mouse = u64::MAX;
260:     client.send(control::ControlCmd::Touch {
261:         action: 7,
262:         pointer_id: mouse,
263:         x: 640,
264:         y: 1386,
265:     });
266:     client.send(control::ControlCmd::Touch {
267:         action: 7,
268:         pointer_id: mouse,
269:         x: 700,
270:         y: 1400,
271:     });
272:     std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
273:     check("协议注入(hover)", client.is_connected(), "");
274: 
275:     drop(client);
276:     drop(server);
277:     println!(
278:         "{}",
279:         if failed {
280:             "存在失败项"
281:         } else {
282:             "全部通过"
283:         }
284:     );
285:     if failed { 1 } else { 0 }
286: }

(End of file - total 286 lines)

1: //! 注入轨迹(trace):把"引擎收到了什么输入"与"往设备发了什么命令"落成 **同一根时间轴** 上的 jsonl。
2: //!
3: //! # 为什么需要它(用户 2026-10-11 的决定)
4: //!
5: //! 上一批"只有真机能暴露"的 bug,根因不是缺方案,而是**缺可回放的现场**:
6: //! 真机上出现了、日志里只有几个计数、复现全靠手感。有了这条轨迹,真机复现一次
7: //! 就得到一份**回归资产** —— 由 [`crate::sim`] 的假设备回放输入、断言注入序列
8: //! 的不变量(位移守恒 / 触点不泄漏 / 坐标合法),同一个问题不必再靠真机碰运气。
9: //!
10: //! # 开关与开销
11: //!
12: //! `SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE=<路径.jsonl>` 打开。**不设时热路径只多一次 `Relaxed`
13: //! 原子读**,与既有的 `diag_*` 宏同一量级;写文件全部落在同一把锁上、按行
14: //! 落盘,只在开启时才发生。
15: //!
16: //! 记录格式(每行一条,`t` = 自打开轨迹起的毫秒):
17: //!
18: //! ```text
19: //! {"t":12,"k":"in","e":"btn","code":67,"down":true}
20: //! {"t":13,"k":"in","e":"motion","dx":12.0,"dy":-3.0}
21: //! {"t":14,"k":"out","e":"touch","a":0,"pid":3000,"x":640,"y":1386}
22: //! {"t":15,"k":"out","e":"key","a":0,"code":4}
23: //! ```
24: 
25: #![allow(dead_code)]

27: use std::fs::File;
28: use std::io::{BufWriter, Write};
29: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
30: use std::sync::Mutex;
31: use std::sync::OnceLock;
32: use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
33: use std::time::Instant;
34: 
35: use crate::control::{ACTION_DOWN, ACTION_MOVE, ACTION_UP, ControlCmd};
36: 
37: /// 一个进程只开一条轨迹(与诊断日志同一纪律:不设就该是零开销)。
38: struct Sink {
39:     start: Instant,
40:     w: Mutex<BufWriter<File>>,
41: }
42: 
43: static ON: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
44: static SINK: OnceLock<Sink> = OnceLock::new();
45: 
46: /// 打开一条轨迹。
47: ///
48: /// **失败必须留下痕迹**:用户是"打完整整一局才发现文件没生成"的(2026-10-11),
49: /// 所以这里既写 stderr,也写诊断日志 —— 双击启动时看不到 stderr,但日志看得到。
50: fn open(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {
51:     let f = File::create(path)?;
52:     let _ = SINK.set(Sink {
53:         start: Instant::now(),
54:         w: Mutex::new(BufWriter::new(f)),
55:     });
56:     ON.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
57:     crate::diag_info!("trace", "注入轨迹已开启: {}", path.display());
58:     println!("[trace] 注入轨迹已开启: {}", path.display());
59:     Ok(())
60: }
61: 
62: /// 没给路径时的落盘位置:配置目录下带时间戳的文件(与其它配置同目录,好找)。
63: fn default_path() -> PathBuf {
64:     let dir = crate::app::config_dir();
65:     let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
66:     let secs = std::time::SystemTime::now()
67:         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
68:         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
69:         .unwrap_or(0);
70:     dir.join(format!("trace-{secs}.jsonl"))
71: }

73: /// 命令行开关(推荐用法):`--trace [路径]`。
74: ///
75: /// 为什么必须有它:`SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE` 这类环境变量在**双击图标启动**时不会被
76: /// 继承 —— 用户按说明复现了一整局,文件根本没生成(2026-10-11 实测:全盘搜不到)。
77: /// 命令行参数一定跟着进程走,是唯一不会丢现场的方式。没给 `--trace` 时回落到环境变量。
78: pub fn init_from_args(args: &[String]) -> Option<PathBuf> {
79:     let mut it = args.iter();
80:     while let Some(a) = it.next() {
81:         if a != "--trace" {
82:             continue;
83:         }
84:         // 紧跟其后、不以 `--` 开头的参数当作路径;否则用默认名。
85:         let path = match it.next() {
86:             Some(p) if !p.starts_with("--") => PathBuf::from(p),
87:             _ => default_path(),
88:         };
89:         if let Err(e) = open(&path) {
90:             eprintln!("trace: 无法创建 {}: {e}", path.display());
91:             crate::diag_warn!("trace", "无法创建轨迹文件 {}: {e}", path.display());
92:         }
93:         return Some(path);
94:     }
95:     init_from_env();
96:     None
97: }

99: /// 环境变量开关(`SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE=<路径>`);命令行没给 `--trace` 时才看它。
100: pub fn init_from_env() {
101:     let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE") else {
102:         return;
103:     };
104:     if path.is_empty() {
105:         return;
106:     }
107:     let path = PathBuf::from(path);
108:     if let Err(e) = open(&path) {
109:         eprintln!("trace: 无法创建 {}: {e}", path.display());
110:         crate::diag_warn!("trace", "无法创建轨迹文件 {}: {e}", path.display());
111:     }
112: }

114: pub fn enabled() -> bool {
115:     ON.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
116: }
117: 
118: fn write_line(line: String) {
119:     let Some(sink) = SINK.get() else { return };
120:     // 锁中毒不放弃:轨迹是排查工具,不能因为它自己出问题就拖垮输入线程。
121:     let mut w = sink.w.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
122:     let _ = writeln!(w, "{line}");
123:     // **逐行落盘**,不靠用户态缓冲。第一版用纯 `BufWriter` 的结果是:一次场景
124:     // 跑完、文件是**空的** —— 静态 `SINK` 永远不会被 drop,`BufWriter` 里那点
125:     // 尾巴(小轨迹就是全部)再没机会写出去。真机上"复现完发现文件没内容"
126:     // 比慢一点严重得多,所以这里每行一次 write 系统调用。
127:     let _ = w.flush();
128: }
129: 
130: fn now_ms() -> u128 {
131:     SINK.get()
132:         .map(|s| s.start.elapsed().as_millis())
133:         .unwrap_or(0)
134: }

136: /// 捕获层的一个按键事件(键盘与鼠标键同码空间)。
137: pub fn button(code: u16, pressed: bool) {
138:     if !enabled() {
139:         return;
140:     }
141:     write_line(format!(
142:         r#"{{"t":{},"k":"in","e":"btn","code":{},"down":{}}}"#,
143:         now_ms(),
144:         code,
145:         pressed
146:     ));
147: }
148: 
149: /// 捕获层的一次鼠标相对位移(设备计数,非像素)。
150: pub fn motion(dx: f32, dy: f32) {
151:     if !enabled() {
152:         return;
153:     }
154:     write_line(format!(
155:         r#"{{"t":{},"k":"in","e":"motion","dx":{},"dy":{}}}"#,
156:         now_ms(),
157:         dx,
158:         dy
159:     ));
160: }
161: 
162: /// 真正写进 socket 的那一条控制命令(在写线程里、序列化之前调用)。
163: ///
164: /// 位置很关键:这里是**唯一的真相** —— 队列可能丢旧保新、写线程可能失败,
165: /// 只有这一步是"确实要发给设备的东西"。
166: pub fn out(cmd: &ControlCmd) {
167:     if !enabled() {
168:         return;
169:     }
170:     let t = now_ms();
171:     let line = match cmd {
172:         ControlCmd::Touch {
173:             action,
174:             pointer_id,
175:             x,
176:             y,
177:         } => format!(
178:             r#"{{"t":{t},"k":"out","e":"touch","a":{action},"pid":{pointer_id},"x":{x},"y":{y}}}"#
179:         ),
180:         ControlCmd::Key { action, keycode } => {
181:             format!(r#"{{"t":{t},"k":"out","e":"key","a":{action},"code":{keycode}}}"#)
182:         }
183:         ControlCmd::UhidCreate { id, .. } => {
184:             format!(r#"{{"t":{t},"k":"out","e":"uhid_create","id":{id}}}"#)
185:         }
186:         ControlCmd::UhidInput { id, .. } => {
187:             format!(r#"{{"t":{t},"k":"out","e":"uhid_input","id":{id}}}"#)
188:         }
189:         ControlCmd::UhidDestroy { id } => {
190:             format!(r#"{{"t":{t},"k":"out","e":"uhid_destroy","id":{id}}}"#)
191:         }
192:     };
193:     write_line(line);
194: }

196: /// 把缓冲区刷出去(退出前调用)。
197: ///
198: /// `write_line` 已经逐行落盘,所以这里**不是**正确性依赖 —— 保留它有两个理由:
199: /// 调用点的语义是完整的("要退出了,把轨迹收干净"),以及将来若改成批量写,
200: /// 这一处不必再回头补。
201: /// **链路状态心跳**(每 200ms 一拍,由捕获层消费线程写)。
202: ///
203: /// 为什么必须有它:只靠 in/out 两条流分不清"没人发"与"发了却被某一环吞掉" ——
204: /// 真机那个"视角锁死"就卡在这个歧义上(2026-10-11:锁死期间 motion=0、按键照常)。
205: /// 有了这一拍,轨迹自己就能回答三件事:
206: /// * `raw` = 位移状态机(`0` 未注册 / `1` 待定 / `2` 已接管 / `3` 仅绝对设备);
207: /// * `wmin` = 累计收到的 `WM_INPUT` 条数(不涨 = 这条通道没在跑);
208: /// * **这些行本身还在不在**(停 = 消费线程卡死/退出,那才是"位移断了、按键还在"
209: ///   的直接解释)。
210: ///
211: /// `now` 是捕获层自己的毫秒时钟,用来与 `t`(轨迹时钟)对齐。
212: pub fn state(raw_state: u8, wm_input: u64, drop_streak_ms: u64, capture_ms: u64) {
213:     if !enabled() {
214:         return;
215:     }
216:     write_line(format!(
217:         r#"{{"t":{},"k":"st","raw":{raw_state},"wmin":{wm_input},"streak":{drop_streak_ms},"now":{capture_ms}}}"#,
218:         now_ms()
219:     ));
220: }
221: 
222: /// **瞄准/模式状态心跳**(引擎每轮维护写一次,量很小)。
223: ///
224: /// 为什么必须有它:真机那个"鼠标在动、视角却转不动"已经排除了捕获层(位移确实
225: /// 到了引擎、触点无泄漏、通道没断),剩下的全在引擎这一侧,而引擎的内部状态
226: /// **此前完全不可见**。这一行把七个判据摊开:
227: /// `en`=总映射开 / `mode`=FPS 模式锁存 / `susp`=按住才退出 / `gate`=门控键 /
228: /// `anchor`=锚点已设 / `down`=瞄准指正按着 / `others`=其它触点数。
229: ///
230: /// 症状出现时只要看这一行:是 `mode` 掉了、还是 `gate` 掉了、还是 `others`
231: /// 把池子占满导致落不下指 —— 三者对应三种完全不同的修法。
232: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
233: pub fn aim_state(
234:     mapping_on: bool,
235:     mode_active: bool,
236:     suspended: bool,
237:     gate_down: bool,
238:     anchor_set: bool,
239:     down: bool,
240:     others: usize,
241: ) {
242:     if !enabled() {
243:         return;
244:     }
245:     write_line(format!(
246:         r#"{{"t":{},"k":"aim","en":{},"mode":{},"susp":{},"gate":{},"anchor":{},"down":{},"others":{}}}"#,
247:         now_ms(),
248:         mapping_on as u8,
249:         mode_active as u8,
250:         suspended as u8,
251:         gate_down as u8,
252:         anchor_set as u8,
253:         down as u8,
254:         others
255:     ));
256: }

258: pub fn flush() {
259:     if let Some(sink) = SINK.get() {
260:         let mut w = sink.w.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
261:         let _ = w.flush();
262:     }
263: }

265: // ============================ 读取(回放用) ============================
266: 
267: /// 一条记录。回放器([`crate::sim::replay`])只认这三种。
268: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
269: pub enum Rec {
270:     Button { t: u64, code: u16, down: bool },
271:     Motion { t: u64, dx: f32, dy: f32 },
272:     Out(OutRec),
273: }
274: 
275: /// 一条"往设备发出去"的记录。
276: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
277: pub enum OutRec {
278:     Touch {
279:         t: u64,
280:         action: u8,
281:         pid: u64,
282:         x: u32,
283:         y: u32,
284:     },
285:     Key {
286:         t: u64,
287:         action: u8,
288:         keycode: u32,
289:     },
290:     Other {
291:         t: u64,
292:         kind: String,
293:     },
294: }
295: 
296: impl Rec {
297:     pub fn t(&self) -> u64 {
298:         match self {
299:             Rec::Button { t, .. } | Rec::Motion { t, .. } => *t,
300:             Rec::Out(o) => match o {
301:                 OutRec::Touch { t, .. } | OutRec::Key { t, .. } | OutRec::Other { t, .. } => *t,
302:             },
303:         }
304:     }
305: }
306: 
307: /// 读一份轨迹。无法识别的行跳过(轨迹是排查工具:半截文件也该能读多少算多少)。
308: pub fn read(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<Vec<Rec>> {
309:     let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path)?;
310:     let mut out = Vec::new();
311:     for line in text.lines() {
312:         let line = line.trim();
313:         if line.is_empty() {
314:             continue;
315:         }
316:         let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(line) else {
317:             continue;
318:         };
319:         let t = v.get("t").and_then(|t| t.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
320:         let k = v.get("k").and_then(|k| k.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
321:         let e = v.get("e").and_then(|e| e.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
322:         match (k, e) {
323:             ("in", "btn") => {
324:                 let (Some(code), Some(down)) = (
325:                     v.get("code").and_then(|c| c.as_u64()),
326:                     v.get("down").and_then(|d| d.as_bool()),
327:                 ) else {
328:                     continue;
329:                 };
330:                 out.push(Rec::Button {
331:                     t,
332:                     code: code as u16,
333:                     down,
334:                 });
335:             }
336:             ("in", "motion") => {
337:                 let (Some(dx), Some(dy)) = (
338:                     v.get("dx").and_then(|d| d.as_f64()),
339:                     v.get("dy").and_then(|d| d.as_f64()),
340:                 ) else {
341:                     continue;
342:                 };
343:                 out.push(Rec::Motion {
344:                     t,
345:                     dx: dx as f32,
346:                     dy: dy as f32,
347:                 });
348:             }
349:             ("out", "touch") => {
350:                 let (Some(a), Some(pid), Some(x), Some(y)) = (
351:                     v.get("a").and_then(|a| a.as_u64()),
352:                     v.get("pid").and_then(|p| p.as_u64()),
353:                     v.get("x").and_then(|x| x.as_u64()),
354:                     v.get("y").and_then(|y| y.as_u64()),
355:                 ) else {
356:                     continue;
357:                 };
358:                 out.push(Rec::Out(OutRec::Touch {
359:                     t,
360:                     action: a as u8,
361:                     pid,
362:                     x: x as u32,
363:                     y: y as u32,
364:                 }));
365:             }
366:             ("out", "key") => {
367:                 let (Some(a), Some(code)) = (
368:                     v.get("a").and_then(|a| a.as_u64()),
369:                     v.get("code").and_then(|c| c.as_u64()),
370:                 ) else {
371:                     continue;
372:                 };
373:                 out.push(Rec::Out(OutRec::Key {
374:                     t,
375:                     action: a as u8,
376:                     keycode: code as u32,
377:                 }));
378:             }
379:             ("out", other) => out.push(Rec::Out(OutRec::Other {
380:                 t,
381:                 kind: other.to_string(),
382:             })),
383:             _ => {}
384:         }
385:     }
386:     Ok(out)
387: }

389: /// 轨迹里的人话摘要(手工排查与 `--scenario` 的报告都用它)。
390: pub fn summarize(recs: &[Rec]) -> String {
391:     let mut buttons = 0usize;
392:     let mut motions = 0usize;
393:     let mut down = 0usize;
394:     let mut up = 0usize;
395:     let mut moves = 0usize;
396:     let mut keys = 0usize;
397:     for r in recs {
398:         match r {
399:             Rec::Button { .. } => buttons += 1,
400:             Rec::Motion { .. } => motions += 1,
401:             Rec::Out(OutRec::Touch { action, .. }) => match *action {
402:                 ACTION_DOWN => down += 1,
403:                 ACTION_UP => up += 1,
404:                 ACTION_MOVE => moves += 1,
405:                 _ => {}
406:             },
407:             Rec::Out(OutRec::Key { .. }) => keys += 1,
408:             Rec::Out(OutRec::Other { .. }) => {}
409:         }
410:     }
411:     format!(
412:         "输入 {buttons} 键 / {motions} 位移;注入 down {down} / move {moves} / up {up} / 系统键 {keys}"
413:     )
414: }

lines.text: //! 注入轨迹(trace):把"引擎收到了什么输入"与"往设备发了什么命令"落成 **同一根时间轴** 上的 jsonl。
//! # 为什么需要它(用户 2026-10-11 的决定)
//! 上一批"只有真机能暴露"的 bug,根因不是缺方案,而是**缺可回放的现场**:
//! 真机上出现了、日志里只有几个计数、复现全靠手感。有了这条轨迹,真机复现一次
//! 就得到一份**回归资产** —— 由 [`crate::sim`] 的假设备回放输入、断言注入序列
//! 的不变量(位移守恒 / 触点不泄漏 / 坐标合法),同一个问题不必再靠真机碰运气。
//! `SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE=<路径.jsonl>` 打开。**不设时热路径只多一次 `Relaxed`
//! 原子读**,与既有的 `diag_*` 宏同一量级;写文件全部落在同一把锁上、按行
//! 落盘,只在开启时才发生。
//! 记录格式(每行一条,`t` = 自打开轨迹起的毫秒):
/// 一个进程只开一条轨迹(与诊断日志同一纪律:不设就该是零开销)。
/// **失败必须留下痕迹**:用户是"打完整整一局才发现文件没生成"的(2026-10-11),
/// 所以这里既写 stderr,也写诊断日志 —— 双击启动时看不到 stderr,但日志看得到。
println!("[trace] 注入轨迹已开启: {}", path.display());
/// 没给路径时的落盘位置:配置目录下带时间戳的文件(与其它配置同目录,好找)。
/// 命令行开关(推荐用法):`--trace [路径]`。
/// 为什么必须有它:`SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE` 这类环境变量在**双击图标启动**时不会被
/// 继承 —— 用户按说明复现了一整局,文件根本没生成(2026-10-11 实测:全盘搜不到)。
/// 命令行参数一定跟着进程走,是唯一不会丢现场的方式。没给 `--trace` 时回落到环境变量。
// 紧跟其后、不以 `--` 开头的参数当作路径;否则用默认名。
crate::diag_warn!("trace", "无法创建轨迹文件 {}: {e}", path.display());
/// 环境变量开关(`SCRCPY_PAD_TRACE=<路径>`);命令行没给 `--trace` 时才看它。
crate::diag_warn!("trace", "无法创建轨迹文件 {}: {e}", path.display());
// 锁中毒不放弃:轨迹是排查工具,不能因为它自己出问题就拖垮输入线程。
// **逐行落盘**,不靠用户态缓冲。第一版用纯 `BufWriter` 的结果是:一次场景
// 跑完、文件是**空的** —— 静态 `SINK` 永远不会被 drop,`BufWriter` 里那点
// 尾巴(小轨迹就是全部)再没机会写出去。真机上"复现完发现文件没内容"
// 比慢一点严重得多,所以这里每行一次 write 系统调用。
/// 捕获层的一个按键事件(键盘与鼠标键同码空间)。
pub fn button(code: u16, pressed: bool) {
/// 捕获层的一次鼠标相对位移(设备计数,非像素)。
pub fn motion(dx: f32, dy: f32) {
/// 真正写进 socket 的那一条控制命令(在写线程里、序列化之前调用)。
/// 位置很关键:这里是**唯一的真相** —— 队列可能丢旧保新、写线程可能失败,
/// 只有这一步是"确实要发给设备的东西"。
/// 把缓冲区刷出去(退出前调用)。
/// `write_line` 已经逐行落盘,所以这里**不是**正确性依赖 —— 保留它有两个理由:
/// 调用点的语义是完整的("要退出了,把轨迹收干净"),以及将来若改成批量写,
/// **链路状态心跳**(每 200ms 一拍,由捕获层消费线程写)。
/// 为什么必须有它:只靠 in/out 两条流分不清"没人发"与"发了却被某一环吞掉" ——
/// 真机那个"视角锁死"就卡在这个歧义上(2026-10-11:锁死期间 motion=0、按键照常)。
/// 有了这一拍,轨迹自己就能回答三件事:
/// * `raw` = 位移状态机(`0` 未注册 / `1` 待定 / `2` 已接管 / `3` 仅绝对设备);
/// * `wmin` = 累计收到的 `WM_INPUT` 条数(不涨 = 这条通道没在跑);
/// * **这些行本身还在不在**(停 = 消费线程卡死/退出,那才是"位移断了、按键还在"
/// `now` 是捕获层自己的毫秒时钟,用来与 `t`(轨迹时钟)对齐。
pub fn state(raw_state: u8, wm_input: u64, drop_streak_ms: u64, capture_ms: u64) {
/// **瞄准/模式状态心跳**(引擎每轮维护写一次,量很小)。
/// 为什么必须有它:真机那个"鼠标在动、视角却转不动"已经排除了捕获层(位移确实
/// 到了引擎、触点无泄漏、通道没断),剩下的全在引擎这一侧,而引擎的内部状态
/// **此前完全不可见**。这一行把七个判据摊开:
/// `en`=总映射开 / `mode`=FPS 模式锁存 / `susp`=按住才退出 / `gate`=门控键 /
/// `anchor`=锚点已设 / `down`=瞄准指正按着 / `others`=其它触点数。
/// 症状出现时只要看这一行:是 `mode` 掉了、还是 `gate` 掉了、还是 `others`
/// 把池子占满导致落不下指 —— 三者对应三种完全不同的修法。
/// 一条记录。回放器([`crate::sim::replay`])只认这三种。
Button { t: u64, code: u16, down: bool },
Motion { t: u64, dx: f32, dy: f32 },
/// 一条"往设备发出去"的记录。
OutRec::Touch { t, .. } | OutRec::Key { t, .. } | OutRec::Other { t, .. } => *t,
/// 读一份轨迹。无法识别的行跳过(轨迹是排查工具:半截文件也该能读多少算多少)。
/// 轨迹里的人话摘要(手工排查与 `--scenario` 的报告都用它)。
"输入 {buttons} 键 / {motions} 位移;注入 down {down} / move {moves} / up {up} / 系统键 {keys}"
/// 常量必须与协议一致 —— 轨迹里的 `a` 字段就是它们,读错了会让整份回放失真。
/// 写→读 往返:四种记录都能原样回来。
// 坏行与未知类型都不许让整份文件读不出来
/// 摘要必须把三类注入分开数 —— 排查"只按下没抬起"时第一眼看的就是它。

1: //! 底层诊断日志(`diagnostics.log`):把"只在别人机器上才复现"的问题变成可回读的现场。
2: //!
3: //! 为什么必须有它:外接键盘失灵、FPS 瞄准在老系统上没反应、偶发断触这几类问题
4: //! 全是**偶发 + 跨设备 + 平台相关**的。而 Windows GUI 版根本没有控制台,
5: //! 原先散落各处的那几处 `eprintln!` 全部进黑洞;线程 panic 也没人接
6: //! (从未安装 panic hook),崩溃之后一无所获 —— 于是任何修复都只能靠猜。
7: //!
8: //! 三条设计约束,违反任何一条都会让它失去意义:
9: //!
10: //! 1. **绝不 panic**。日志写失败不能拖垮程序:所有 IO 一律 `let _ =`,
11: //!    目录只读就退化成"只写 stderr",绝不 `unwrap`。
12: //! 2. **崩溃现场的最后一句话必须已经落盘**。`ERROR`/`WARN` 立即 flush;
13: //!    panic hook 里也强制 flush —— 不能等 `BufWriter` 自然溢出,
14: //!    否则最关键的那几行会随进程一起消失。
15: //! 3. **高频事件不得逐条写盘**。鼠标位移在 1000Hz 鼠标上每秒上千条,
16: //!    调用方必须先聚合成计数/最近值(见 `engine` 的 `AimLive`/`EngineLive`),
17: //!    只在**状态跃迁**时才记一行。这里靠级别过滤与 flush 节流兜底。
18: //!
19: //! 级别由环境变量 `SCRCPY_PAD_LOG`(error/warn/info/debug/trace)控制,默认 `info`;
20: //! 也可由 `settings.json` 的 `log_level` 覆盖(见 [`set_level_from_str`]),
21: //! 后者是给 GUI 用户用的 —— Windows 上设环境变量并不方便。
22: //!
23: //! 文件名与位置:`app::config_dir()/diagnostics.log`,与 `profile.yaml`
24: //! 同级。**每次启动截断重写**(用户要求"每次运行后完全更新");
25: //! 因此崩溃现场会一直保留到你下次启动程序为止。
26: 
27: use std::fmt::Display;
28: use std::fs::File;
29: use std::io::{BufWriter, Write};
30: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
31: use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};
32: use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
33: 
34: /// 日志级别。数值越小越严重,`enabled()` 按"小于等于当前级别"判定。
35: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
36: pub enum Level {
37:     Error = 0,
38:     Warn = 1,
39:     Info = 2,
40:     Debug = 3,
41:     Trace = 4,
42: }
43: 
44: impl Level {
45:     fn short(self) -> &'static str {
46:         match self {
47:             Level::Error => "ERROR",
48:             Level::Warn => "WARN ",
49:             Level::Info => "INFO ",
50:             Level::Debug => "DEBUG",
51:             Level::Trace => "TRACE",
52:         }
53:     }
54: 
55:     /// 解析级别名(大小写不敏感,容错常见写法)
56:     pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<Level> {
57:         match s.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
58:             "error" | "err" | "e" => Some(Level::Error),
59:             "warn" | "warning" | "w" => Some(Level::Warn),
60:             "info" | "i" => Some(Level::Info),
61:             "debug" | "d" => Some(Level::Debug),
62:             "trace" | "t" | "verbose" => Some(Level::Trace),
63:             _ => None,
64:         }
65:     }
66: 
67:     pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
68:         match self {
69:             Level::Error => "error",
70:             Level::Warn => "warn",
71:             Level::Info => "info",
72:             Level::Debug => "debug",
73:             Level::Trace => "trace",
74:         }
75:     }
76: }
77: 
78: /// 日志文件名(与配置同目录)
79: pub const FILE_NAME: &str = "diagnostics.log";
80: /// 控制级别的环境变量名(优先级高于 settings.json)
81: pub const ENV_LEVEL: &str = "SCRCPY_PAD_LOG";
82: /// 正常退出的标记行。下次启动会检查上一次是否以它结尾 ——
83: /// 没有它就意味着上次是崩溃/被强杀,这本身就是一个重要线索。
84: const EXIT_MARKER: &str = "===== 正常退出 =====";
85: /// `INFO` 及以下级别的最大落盘间隔。
86: ///
87: /// 为什么要节流而不是每条都 flush:TRACE 级别下日志量很可观,每条一次 write
88: /// 系统调用会明显拖慢引擎线程(它每 4ms 就转一圈)。500ms 把"崩溃时最多丢多少"
89: /// 限制在一个可控的量,同时把系统调用次数降三个数量级。
90: const FLUSH_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(500);
91: 
92: struct Sink {
93:     file: Option<BufWriter<File>>,
94:     /// 上一次写失败是否已经提示过(避免刷屏)
95:     write_failed_reported: bool,
96: }
97: 
98: struct Diag {
99:     sink: Option<Sink>,
100:     path: PathBuf,
101:     level: Level,
102:     /// 级别是谁定的(写进日志头,便于确认用户的设置到底生效没有)
103:     level_source: String,
104:     start: Instant,
105: }
106: 
107: static STATE: OnceLock<Mutex<Diag>> = OnceLock::new();
108: /// 启动快照的文本副本:界面"导出诊断包"要用,避免重新推导一遍
109: static SNAPSHOT: OnceLock<String> = OnceLock::new();
110: 
111: /// 取全局状态。**中毒也要能用** —— 日志系统一旦罢工,排查就彻底瞎了。
112: fn state() -> &'static Mutex<Diag> {
113:     STATE.get_or_init(|| {
114:         let (level, source) = initial_level();
115:         Mutex::new(Diag {
116:             sink: None,
117:             path: PathBuf::new(),
118:             level,
119:             level_source: source.to_string(),
120:             start: Instant::now(),
121:         })
122:     })
123: }
124: 
125: /// 带容错的加锁:锁被 panic 中毒时仍取出内部数据继续跑。
126: fn lock() -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, Diag> {
127:     state().lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
128: }
129: 
130: /// 初始级别:环境变量优先,否则内置默认 `info`
131: fn initial_level() -> (Level, &'static str) {
132:     match std::env::var(ENV_LEVEL).ok().and_then(|v| Level::parse(&v)) {
133:         Some(l) => (l, "环境变量 SCRCPY_PAD_LOG"),
134:         None => (Level::Info, "内置默认"),
135:     }
136: }
137: 
138: /// 初始化:在配置目录下**截断重写**日志文件,并写入启动头部。
139: ///
140: /// 必须在 `app::PadApp::new()` 之前调用 —— 那里会立刻开始写设备清单,
141: /// 晚一步那些最关键的第一手信息就会丢。
142: pub fn init() {
143:     let path = crate::app::config_dir().join(FILE_NAME);
144:     // 先看上一份日志的结尾(Create 会把内容冲掉,必须在此之前读)
145:     let prev_abnormal = previous_run_was_abnormal(&path);
146: 
147:     let mut file = None;
148:     match File::create(&path) {
149:         Ok(f) => file = Some(BufWriter::new(f)),
150:         Err(e) => eprintln!(
151:             "[diag] 无法创建 {}: {e} —— 诊断日志将只输出到 stderr(便携模式 + 只读介质?)",
152:             path.display()
153:         ),
154:     }
155: 
156:     {
157:         let mut st = lock();
158:         st.start = Instant::now();
159:         st.path = path.clone();
160:         st.sink = file.map(|f| Sink {
161:             file: Some(f),
162:             write_failed_reported: false,
163:         });
164:     }
165: 
166:     for line in header_lines() {
167:         write_raw(&line);
168:     }
169:     if let Some(secs) = stale_seconds(&path) {
170:         write_raw(&format!(
171:             "# 上一份日志的最后修改时间: {} ({secs} 秒前)",
172:             fmt_time(now_secs())
173:         ));
174:     }
175:     if prev_abnormal {
176:         write_raw(
177:             "# 上一份日志**没有**以正常退出标记结尾 —— 上次运行是崩溃或被强杀,请检查其中是否有 ERROR。",
178:         );
179:     }
180:     flush();
181:     // 落盘线程必须在头部写完、且任何 `log()` 之前起好,否则最早的几行
182:     // (恰恰是最有价值的启动现场)会等到下一次写日志才落地
183:     spawn_flusher();
184: }
185: 
186: /// 启动头部:程序版本、构建目标、级别来源、日志自身位置
187: fn header_lines() -> Vec<String> {
188:     let (level, source) = {
189:         let st = lock();
190:         (st.level, st.level_source.clone())
191:     };
192:     vec![
193:         "# ============================================================".to_string(),
194:         format!(
195:             "# scrcpy-pad 诊断日志 v{} ({}, {})",
196:             env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
197:             std::env::consts::OS,
198:             std::env::consts::ARCH
199:         ),
200:         format!(
201:             "# 级别 {} ({source});改成更详细:设环境变量 {ENV_LEVEL}=debug/trace,",
202:             level.name()
203:         ),
204:         format!("#   或在 settings.json 里写 \"log_level\": \"debug\"。文件每次启动整体重写。"),
205:         format!("# 文件: {}", lock().path.display()),
206:         format!("# 起始时间: {}", fmt_time(now_secs())),
207:         "# 时间戳: [+相对启动毫秒][绝对本地时间]  —— 相对时间用于分析延迟/竞态,".to_string(),
208:         "#   绝对时间可直接与 journalctl / 事件查看器对齐。".to_string(),
209:         "# ============================================================".to_string(),
210:     ]
211: }
212: 
213: /// 上一次运行是否异常结束(日志文件末尾没有正常退出标记)
214: fn previous_run_was_abnormal(path: &Path) -> bool {
215:     let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(path) else {
216:         return false; // 没有上一份,不算异常
217:     };
218:     if bytes.is_empty() {
219:         return false;
220:     }
221:     let tail = &bytes[bytes.len().saturating_sub(512)..];
222:     !String::from_utf8_lossy(tail).contains(EXIT_MARKER)
223: }
224: 
225: /// 日志文件的最后修改时间距现在多少秒(用于"上一份日志有多旧")
226: fn stale_seconds(path: &Path) -> Option<u64> {
227:     let m = std::fs::metadata(path).ok()?;
228:     let t = m.modified().ok()?;
229:     let secs = t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok()?.as_secs();
230:     now_secs().checked_sub(secs)
231: }
232: 
233: /// 当前级别够不够详细
234: pub fn enabled(level: Level) -> bool {
235:     level <= lock().level
236: }
237: 
238: /// 当前级别(界面显示用)
239: pub fn level() -> Level {
240:     lock().level
241: }
242: 
243: /// 级别来源说明(界面显示用,回答"我设的到底生效没有")
244: pub fn level_source() -> String {
245:     lock().level_source.clone()
246: }
247: 
248: /// 运行期改级别(settings.json 的 log_level 会在启动后调用它)
249: pub fn set_level(level: Level, source: &str) {
250:     {
251:         let mut st = lock();
252:         st.level = level;
253:         st.level_source = source.to_string();
254:     }
255:     log(
256:         Level::Info,
257:         "diag",
258:         format_args!("日志级别已设为 {} ({source})", level.name()),
259:     );
260: }

262: /// 按字符串设置级别(来自 settings.json);无法识别时保持原样并说明
263: pub fn set_level_from_str(s: &str, source: &str) {
264:     match Level::parse(s) {
265:         Some(l) => set_level(l, source),
266:         None if s.trim().is_empty() => {}
267:         None => log(
268:             Level::Warn,
269:             "diag",
270:             format_args!("无法识别的日志级别 {s:?}(可用 error/warn/info/debug/trace),保持原级别"),
271:         ),
272:     }
273: }

275: /// 日志文件路径(界面"打开日志目录"用)
276: pub fn path() -> PathBuf {
277:     lock().path.clone()
278: }

280: /// 记一行(受级别过滤)。`tag` 是模块名,便于 `grep '\[capture\]'` 这类过滤。
281: pub fn log(level: Level, tag: &str, msg: impl Display) {
282:     if !enabled(level) {
283:         return;
284:     }
285:     let line = format_line(level, tag, &format!("{msg}"));
286:     // WARN/ERROR 一律同时打到 stderr(journalctl / 终端能直接看到);
287:     // 文件不可用时退化成"全部级别都打 stderr",否则就什么都看不到了。
288:     let file_broken = {
289:         let st = lock();
290:         st.sink.as_ref().map(|s| s.file.is_none()).unwrap_or(true)
291:     };
292:     if level <= Level::Warn || file_broken {
293:         eprintln!("{line}");
294:     }
295:     write_raw(&line);
296:     if level <= Level::Warn {
297:         flush();
298:     }
299: }
300: 
301: /// 写一行,**不过滤级别**也不打 stderr(头部、快照这类程序自己产出的内容用它)
302: ///
303: /// 这里只写进 `BufWriter`,**不做节流落盘** —— 落盘交给 [`spawn_flusher`] 的
304: /// 定时线程。原因:如果把"该不该 flush"挂在"有没有新日志"上,那么一旦程序
305: /// 忙起来或者干脆不再写日志(典型场景:主线程在解码一张很大的背景图、
306: /// 或者用户只是没碰键盘),缓冲区里的尾巴就会一直留着,进程被强杀时直接丢光。
307: /// 定时线程与主线程是否忙无关,能把"崩溃时最多丢多久"稳定限制在 500ms 以内。
308: fn write_raw(line: &str) {
309:     let mut guard = lock();
310:     // 一次性把字段拆开:`st.sink.as_mut()` 会借用整个 `*guard`(Deref 之后
311:     // 借用检查看不到字段互不相交),那样后面再用别的字段就会冲突。
312:     let Diag { sink, .. } = &mut *guard;
313:     let Some(sink) = sink.as_mut() else { return };
314:     let Some(f) = sink.file.as_mut() else { return };
315:     if writeln!(f, "{line}").is_err() && !sink.write_failed_reported {
316:         sink.write_failed_reported = true;
317:         // 此处不能调 log(会把锁再借一次),直接打 stderr
318:         eprintln!("[diag] 诊断日志写入失败(后续不再提示)");
319:     }
320: }
321: 
322: /// 起一个只看时间的落盘线程。
323: ///
324: /// 这是"日志可信"的最后一道保险:`ERROR`/`WARN` 仍然即时落盘(见 [`log`]),
325: /// 而 `INFO` 及以下靠它每 [`FLUSH_INTERVAL`] 落一次。没有它,日志的尾巴
326: /// 就取决于"程序接下来还写不写日志",这是不可接受的 —— 最需要日志的时刻
327: /// 恰恰是程序忙死或已经不动的时候。
328: fn spawn_flusher() {
329:     std::thread::Builder::new()
330:         .name("diag-flush".into())
331:         .spawn(|| {
332:             loop {
333:                 std::thread::sleep(FLUSH_INTERVAL);
334:                 // 缓冲区为空时 BufWriter::flush 不会发起系统调用,所以空转几乎不花钱
335:                 flush();
336:             }
337:         })
338:         .ok();
339: }
340: 
341: /// 强制落盘。退出前、panic 时、以及界面点了"导出"之后必须调用。
342: pub fn flush() {
343:     let mut st = lock();
344:     if let Some(sink) = st.sink.as_mut() {
345:         if let Some(f) = sink.file.as_mut() {
346:             let _ = f.flush();
347:         }
348:     }
349: }

351: /// 正常退出:打标记并落盘。下次启动靠这个标记判断上次是否异常结束。
352: pub fn shutdown() {
353:     log(Level::Info, "diag", format_args!("{EXIT_MARKER}"));
354:     flush();
355: }

357: /// 组装一行:`[+相对ms][绝对时间][级别][tag][线程] 消息`
358: fn format_line(level: Level, tag: &str, msg: &str) -> String {
359:     let ms = lock().start.elapsed().as_millis();
360:     let thread = std::thread::current();
361:     let tname = thread.name().unwrap_or("unnamed");
362:     // 消息里带换行时缩进后续行,避免把日志的"一行一事件"结构冲垮
363:     let msg = msg.replace('\n', "\n    ");
364:     format!(
365:         "[+{ms:>7}ms][{}][{}][{tag}][{tname}] {msg}",
366:         fmt_time_ms(),
367:         level.short()
368:     )
369: }

371: /// 安装 panic hook:把"哪个线程、哪一行、什么原因、什么调用栈"完整落盘。
372: ///
373: /// 为什么必须装:引擎线程一旦 panic,映射就整体失效,而用户侧只看到
374: /// "程序还在,但按什么都没反应" —— 没有这份记录,这种问题无法定位。
375: /// 另外线程 panicking 时会 drop 掉 `Receiver`,捕获层的每次 `send` 从此静默失败,
376: /// 表现同样是"彻底失去输入"。
377: pub fn install_panic_hook() {
378:     let default_hook = std::panic::take_hook();
379:     std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |info| {
380:         let payload = info
381:             .payload()
382:             .downcast_ref::<&str>()
383:             .map(|s| (*s).to_string())
384:             .or_else(|| info.payload().downcast_ref::<String>().cloned())
385:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "(无法读取 panic 信息)".to_string());
386:         let location = info
387:             .location()
388:             .map(|l| format!("{}:{}:{}", l.file(), l.line(), l.column()))
389:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "(位置未知)".to_string());
390:         let tname = std::thread::current()
391:             .name()
392:             .unwrap_or("unnamed")
393:             .to_string();
394: 
395:         // 这里必须用 try_lock:若当前线程正持有日志锁(例如在写日志的过程中 panic),
396:         // 再 lock() 就会自己把自己锁死 —— 那样连崩溃信息都留不下。
397:         let text = format!(
398:             "[+?][{}][ERROR][panic][{tname}] 线程崩溃于 {location}: {payload}",
399:             fmt_time_ms()
400:         );
401:         if let Ok(mut st) = state().try_lock() {
402:             if let Some(f) = st.sink.as_mut().and_then(|s| s.file.as_mut()) {
403:                 let _ = writeln!(f, "{text}");
404:                 let _ = writeln!(
405:                     f,
406:                     "[+?][{}][ERROR][panic][{tname}] 回溯(开发版带符号,release 版可能只有地址):\n{}",
407:                     fmt_time_ms(),
408:                     std::backtrace::Backtrace::force_capture()
409:                 );
410:                 let _ = f.flush();
411:             }
412:         }
413:         eprintln!("{text}");
414:         default_hook(info);
415:     }));
416: }

418: /// 启动快照:把"跨设备排错真正需要的环境事实"一次性写进去。
419: ///
420: /// 为什么值得单独一整块:几乎所有"我这里不行你那里行"的问题,
421: /// 答案都在这几行里 —— 发行版/内核、会话类型(Wayland 与 X11 的 grab 行为不同)、
422: /// 用户所属组(有没有 input 组)、配置文件在不在、显示器与缩放。
423: pub fn snapshot_environment() {
424:     let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
425:     lines.push("===== 启动环境快照 =====".to_string());
426:     lines.push(format!(
427:         "程序: scrcpy-pad {} ({}/{}, {} 位)",
428:         env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
429:         std::env::consts::OS,
430:         std::env::consts::ARCH,
431:         usize::BITS
432:     ));
433:     lines.push(format!("系统: {}", os_description()));
434:     lines.push(format!("会话: {}", session_description()));
435:     lines.push(format!("用户: {}", user_and_groups()));
436:     lines.push(format!("显示器: {}", display_description()));
437:     lines.push(format!("进程: pid={}", std::process::id()));
438:     lines.push(format!(
439:         "程序路径: {}",
440:         std::env::current_exe()
441:             .map(|p| p.display().to_string())
442:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| "(未知)".into())
443:     ));
444:     lines.push(format!(
445:         "工作目录: {}",
446:         std::env::current_dir()
447:             .map(|p| p.display().to_string())
448:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| "(未知)".into())
449:     ));
450:     lines.push(format!("配置目录: {}", crate::app::config_dir().display()));
451:     lines.push(format!("配置文件: {}", config_files()));
452:     lines.push(format!("日志级别: {}", level_source()));
453:     lines.push(format!("===== 快照结束 ({}) =====", fmt_time(now_secs())));
454: 
455:     let text = lines.join("\n");
456:     let _ = SNAPSHOT.set(text.clone());
457:     for line in lines {
458:         write_raw(&line);
459:     }
460:     flush();

468: /// 读取日志尾部若干字节(界面预览与导出用;不解析,原样返回)
469: pub fn tail(max_bytes: usize) -> String {
470:     let p = path();
471:     let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&p) else {
472:         return String::new();
473:     };
474:     let start = bytes.len().saturating_sub(max_bytes);
475:     String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes[start..]).into_owned()
476: }

480: #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
481: fn os_description() -> String {
482:     let mut out = String::new();
483:     if let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string("/etc/os-release") {
484:         for line in text.lines() {
485:             if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("PRETTY_NAME=") {
486:                 out.push_str(v.trim_matches('"'));
487:                 break;
488:             }
489:         }
490:     }
491:     if let Ok(k) = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease") {
492:         if !out.is_empty() {
493:             out.push_str(" · ");
494:         }
495:         out.push_str("内核 ");
496:         out.push_str(k.trim());
497:     }
498:     if out.is_empty() {
499:         out.push_str("(未能识别发行版)");
500:     }
501:     out
502: }

504: #[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
505: fn os_description() -> String {
506:     // Windows:OS 变量固定为 "Windows_NT";构建号要额外的系统调用,收益不大
507:     let os = std::env::var("OS").unwrap_or_else(|_| "(未知)".into());
508:     let arch = std::env::var("PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE").unwrap_or_default();
509:     format!("{os} {arch}")
510: }

512: /// 会话类型。Wayland 与 X11 对 evdev 抓取、光标隐藏的行为并不一致,
513: /// 很多"我这儿抓不到按键"的差异都出在这里。
514: fn session_description() -> String {
515:     let mut parts = Vec::new();
516:     for key in [
517:         "XDG_SESSION_TYPE",
518:         "WAYLAND_DISPLAY",
519:         "DISPLAY",
520:         "DESKTOP_SESSION",
521:     ] {
522:         if let Ok(v) = std::env::var(key) {
523:             if !v.trim().is_empty() {
524:                 parts.push(format!("{key}={v}"));
525:             }
526:         }
527:     }
528:     if parts.is_empty() {
529:         "(无图形会话相关环境变量)".into()
530:     } else {
531:         parts.join(" ")
532:     }
533: }

535: /// 当前用户与所属组(是否在 input 组直接决定能否读 /dev/input)
536: #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
537: fn user_and_groups() -> String {
538:     let user = std::env::var("USER").unwrap_or_else(|_| "(未知用户)".into());
539:     let Ok(status) = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/status") else {
540:         return user;
541:     };
542:     let mut uid = None;
543:     let mut gids: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
544:     for line in status.lines() {
545:         if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("Uid:") {
546:             uid = v
547:                 .split_whitespace()
548:                 .next()
549:                 .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok());
550:         } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix("Groups:") {
551:             gids = v
552:                 .split_whitespace()
553:                 .filter_map(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())
554:                 .collect();
555:         }
556:     }
557:     let names = group_names(&gids);
558:     format!(
559:         "{user} uid={} gid=[{}] (含 input 组? {})",
560:         uid.map(|u| u.to_string()).unwrap_or_else(|| "?".into()),
561:         names.join(","),
562:         if names.iter().any(|n| n == "input") {
563:             "是"
564:         } else {
565:             "否 —— 读不到 /dev/input,必须 sudo usermod -aG input $USER 后重新登录"
566:         }
567:     )
568: }

570: /// gid -> 组名(查 /etc/group);查不到就退回数字
571: #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
572: fn group_names(gids: &[u32]) -> Vec<String> {
573:     let text = std::fs::read_to_string("/etc/group").unwrap_or_default();
574:     gids.iter()
575:         .map(|gid| {
576:             text.lines()
577:                 .find_map(|line| {
578:                     let mut it = line.split(':');
579:                     let name = it.next()?;
580:                     it.next()?; // 口令字段
581:                     let g = it.next()?;
582:                     (g.parse::<u32>().ok() == Some(*gid)).then(|| name.to_string())
583:                 })
584:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| gid.to_string())
585:         })
586:         .collect()
587: }

645: // ============================ 时间格式化 ============================
646: 
647: fn now_secs() -> u64 {
648:     SystemTime::now()
649:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
650:         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
651:         .unwrap_or(0)
652: }
653: 
654: /// `epoch 秒 -> 本地时间 "2026-09-27 06:31:02"`
655: ///
656: /// 用系统时区而不是 UTC:诊断日志的价值有一大半在于和 `journalctl` /
657: /// Windows 事件查看器对齐时间线,而那两个工具显示的是本地时间。
658: fn fmt_time(secs: u64) -> String {
659:     let (y, mo, d, h, mi, s, _) = local_parts(secs);
660:     format!("{y:04}-{mo:02}-{d:02} {h:02}:{mi:02}:{s:02}")
661: }
662: 
663: /// 带毫秒的当前本地时间
664: fn fmt_time_ms() -> String {
665:     let st = SystemTime::now()
666:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
667:         .unwrap_or_default();
668:     let (y, mo, d, h, mi, s, ms) = local_parts(st.as_secs());
669:     format!("{y:04}-{mo:02}-{d:02} {h:02}:{mi:02}:{s:02}.{ms:03}")
670: }
671: 
672: /// epoch 秒 -> 本地时间各分量 (年,月,日,时,分,秒,毫秒)
673: #[cfg(unix)]
674: fn local_parts(secs: u64) -> (i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, u32) {
675:     let ms = SystemTime::now()
676:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
677:         .map(|d| d.subsec_millis())
678:         .unwrap_or(0);
679:     let t: libc::time_t = secs as libc::time_t;
680:     let mut tm: libc::tm = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
681:     // localtime_r 失败(极端时区库缺失)时退回纯 Rust 的 UTC 民用历算法,
682:     // 宁可时间差几个时区,也不能让整行日志丢掉时间戳。
683:     let ok = unsafe { !libc::localtime_r(&t, &mut tm).is_null() };
684:     if !ok {
685:         let (y, mo, d) = civil_from_days((secs as i64).div_euclid(86400));
686:         let rem = (secs as i64).rem_euclid(86400);
687:         return (y, mo, d, rem / 3600, (rem % 3600) / 60, rem % 60, ms);
688:     }
689:     (
690:         tm.tm_year as i64 + 1900,
691:         tm.tm_mon as i64 + 1,
692:         tm.tm_mday as i64,
693:         tm.tm_hour as i64,
694:         tm.tm_min as i64,
695:         tm.tm_sec as i64,
696:         ms,
697:     )
698: }
699: 
700: #[cfg(windows)]
701: fn local_parts(_secs: u64) -> (i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, u32) {
702:     use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::SYSTEMTIME;
703:     use windows_sys::Win32::System::SystemInformation::GetLocalTime;
704:     let mut st: SYSTEMTIME = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
705:     unsafe { GetLocalTime(&mut st) };
706:     (
707:         st.wYear as i64,
708:         st.wMonth as i64,
709:         st.wDay as i64,
710:         st.wHour as i64,
711:         st.wMinute as i64,
712:         st.wSecond as i64,
713:         st.wMilliseconds as u32,
714:     )
715: }
716: 
717: /// 自 epoch 起的天数 -> (年, 月, 日)(Howard Hinnant 民用历算法)。
718: /// 仅在 `localtime_r` 不可用时作为兜底。
719: #[cfg(unix)]
720: fn civil_from_days(z: i64) -> (i64, i64, i64) {
721:     let z = z + 719468;
722:     let era = z.div_euclid(146097);
723:     let doe = z - era * 146097;
724:     let yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36524 - doe / 146096) / 365;
725:     let y = yoe + era * 400;
726:     let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
727:     let mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
728:     let d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1;
729:     let m = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 };
730:     (if m <= 2 { y + 1 } else { y }, m, d)
731: }
732: 
733: // ============================ 便捷宏 ============================
734: 
735: /// `error` 级一行:故障必须留下痕迹,且立即落盘
736: #[macro_export]

739:         $crate::diag::log($crate::diag::Level::Error, $tag, format_args!($($arg)*))
740:     };
741: }

743: /// `warn` 级一行:可疑但不致命(丢事件、被拒绝、降级运行)
744: #[macro_export]
745: macro_rules! diag_warn {

748:     };
749: }

752: #[macro_export]
753: macro_rules! diag_info {
754:     ($tag:expr, $($arg:tt)*) => {

756:     };
757: }

760: #[macro_export]
761: macro_rules! diag_debug {
762:     ($tag:expr, $($arg:tt)*) => {

764:     };
765: }

769: #[macro_export]
770: macro_rules! diag_trace {
771:     ($tag:expr, $($arg:tt)*) => {
772:         $crate::diag::log($crate::diag::Level::Trace, $tag, format_args!($($arg)*))
773:     };
774: }

lines.text: //! 底层诊断日志(`diagnostics.log`):把"只在别人机器上才复现"的问题变成可回读的现场。
//! 为什么必须有它:外接键盘失灵、FPS 瞄准在老系统上没反应、偶发断触这几类问题
//! 全是**偶发 + 跨设备 + 平台相关**的。而 Windows GUI 版根本没有控制台,
//! 原先散落各处的那几处 `eprintln!` 全部进黑洞;线程 panic 也没人接
//! (从未安装 panic hook),崩溃之后一无所获 —— 于是任何修复都只能靠猜。
//! 三条设计约束,违反任何一条都会让它失去意义:
//! 1. **绝不 panic**。日志写失败不能拖垮程序:所有 IO 一律 `let _ =`,
//!    目录只读就退化成"只写 stderr",绝不 `unwrap`。
//! 2. **崩溃现场的最后一句话必须已经落盘**。`ERROR`/`WARN` 立即 flush;
//!    panic hook 里也强制 flush —— 不能等 `BufWriter` 自然溢出,
//!    否则最关键的那几行会随进程一起消失。
//! 3. **高频事件不得逐条写盘**。鼠标位移在 1000Hz 鼠标上每秒上千条,
//!    调用方必须先聚合成计数/最近值(见 `engine` 的 `AimLive`/`EngineLive`),
//!    只在**状态跃迁**时才记一行。这里靠级别过滤与 flush 节流兜底。
//! 级别由环境变量 `SCRCPY_PAD_LOG`(error/warn/info/debug/trace)控制,默认 `info`;
//! 也可由 `settings.json` 的 `log_level` 覆盖(见 [`set_level_from_str`]),
//! 后者是给 GUI 用户用的 —— Windows 上设环境变量并不方便。
//! 同级。**每次启动截断重写**(用户要求"每次运行后完全更新");
//! 因此崩溃现场会一直保留到你下次启动程序为止。
/// 日志级别。数值越小越严重,`enabled()` 按"小于等于当前级别"判定。
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
/// 解析级别名(大小写不敏感,容错常见写法)
/// 日志文件名(与配置同目录)
/// 控制级别的环境变量名(优先级高于 settings.json)
/// 正常退出的标记行。下次启动会检查上一次是否以它结尾 ——
/// 没有它就意味着上次是崩溃/被强杀,这本身就是一个重要线索。
/// `INFO` 及以下级别的最大落盘间隔。
/// 为什么要节流而不是每条都 flush:TRACE 级别下日志量很可观,每条一次 write
/// 系统调用会明显拖慢引擎线程(它每 4ms 就转一圈)。500ms 把"崩溃时最多丢多少"
/// 限制在一个可控的量,同时把系统调用次数降三个数量级。
/// 上一次写失败是否已经提示过(避免刷屏)
/// 级别是谁定的(写进日志头,便于确认用户的设置到底生效没有)
/// 启动快照的文本副本:界面"导出诊断包"要用,避免重新推导一遍
/// 取全局状态。**中毒也要能用** —— 日志系统一旦罢工,排查就彻底瞎了。
/// 带容错的加锁:锁被 panic 中毒时仍取出内部数据继续跑。
/// 初始级别:环境变量优先,否则内置默认 `info`
/// 初始化:在配置目录下**截断重写**日志文件,并写入启动头部。
/// 必须在 `app::PadApp::new()` 之前调用 —— 那里会立刻开始写设备清单,
/// 晚一步那些最关键的第一手信息就会丢。
// 先看上一份日志的结尾(Create 会把内容冲掉,必须在此之前读)
"[diag] 无法创建 {}: {e} —— 诊断日志将只输出到 stderr(便携模式 + 只读介质?)",
"# 上一份日志的最后修改时间: {} ({secs} 秒前)",
"# 上一份日志**没有**以正常退出标记结尾 —— 上次运行是崩溃或被强杀,请检查其中是否有 ERROR。",
// 落盘线程必须在头部写完、且任何 `log()` 之前起好,否则最早的几行
// (恰恰是最有价值的启动现场)会等到下一次写日志才落地
/// 启动头部:程序版本、构建目标、级别来源、日志自身位置
"# 级别 {} ({source});改成更详细:设环境变量 {ENV_LEVEL}=debug/trace,",
format!("#   或在 settings.json 里写 \"log_level\": \"debug\"。文件每次启动整体重写。"),
"# 时间戳: [+相对启动毫秒][绝对本地时间]  —— 相对时间用于分析延迟/竞态,".to_string(),
"#   绝对时间可直接与 journalctl / 事件查看器对齐。".to_string(),
/// 上一次运行是否异常结束(日志文件末尾没有正常退出标记)
return false; // 没有上一份,不算异常
/// 日志文件的最后修改时间距现在多少秒(用于"上一份日志有多旧")
/// 级别来源说明(界面显示用,回答"我设的到底生效没有")
/// 运行期改级别(settings.json 的 log_level 会在启动后调用它)
/// 按字符串设置级别(来自 settings.json);无法识别时保持原样并说明
format_args!("无法识别的日志级别 {s:?}(可用 error/warn/info/debug/trace),保持原级别"),
/// 日志文件路径(界面"打开日志目录"用)
/// 记一行(受级别过滤)。`tag` 是模块名,便于 `grep '\[capture\]'` 这类过滤。
pub fn log(level: Level, tag: &str, msg: impl Display) {
// WARN/ERROR 一律同时打到 stderr(journalctl / 终端能直接看到);
// 文件不可用时退化成"全部级别都打 stderr",否则就什么都看不到了。
/// 写一行,**不过滤级别**也不打 stderr(头部、快照这类程序自己产出的内容用它)
/// 这里只写进 `BufWriter`,**不做节流落盘** —— 落盘交给 [`spawn_flusher`] 的
/// 定时线程。原因:如果把"该不该 flush"挂在"有没有新日志"上,那么一旦程序
/// 忙起来或者干脆不再写日志(典型场景:主线程在解码一张很大的背景图、
/// 或者用户只是没碰键盘),缓冲区里的尾巴就会一直留着,进程被强杀时直接丢光。
/// 定时线程与主线程是否忙无关,能把"崩溃时最多丢多久"稳定限制在 500ms 以内。
// 一次性把字段拆开:`st.sink.as_mut()` 会借用整个 `*guard`(Deref 之后
// 借用检查看不到字段互不相交),那样后面再用别的字段就会冲突。
// 此处不能调 log(会把锁再借一次),直接打 stderr
eprintln!("[diag] 诊断日志写入失败(后续不再提示)");
/// 起一个只看时间的落盘线程。
/// 这是"日志可信"的最后一道保险:`ERROR`/`WARN` 仍然即时落盘(见 [`log`]),
/// 而 `INFO` 及以下靠它每 [`FLUSH_INTERVAL`] 落一次。没有它,日志的尾巴
/// 就取决于"程序接下来还写不写日志",这是不可接受的 —— 最需要日志的时刻
/// 恰恰是程序忙死或已经不动的时候。
// 缓冲区为空时 BufWriter::flush 不会发起系统调用,所以空转几乎不花钱
/// 强制落盘。退出前、panic 时、以及界面点了"导出"之后必须调用。
/// 正常退出:打标记并落盘。下次启动靠这个标记判断上次是否异常结束。
/// 组装一行:`[+相对ms][绝对时间][级别][tag][线程] 消息`
fn format_line(level: Level, tag: &str, msg: &str) -> String {
// 消息里带换行时缩进后续行,避免把日志的"一行一事件"结构冲垮
/// 安装 panic hook:把"哪个线程、哪一行、什么原因、什么调用栈"完整落盘。
/// 为什么必须装:引擎线程一旦 panic,映射就整体失效,而用户侧只看到
/// "程序还在,但按什么都没反应" —— 没有这份记录,这种问题无法定位。
/// 另外线程 panicking 时会 drop 掉 `Receiver`,捕获层的每次 `send` 从此静默失败,
/// 表现同样是"彻底失去输入"。
// 这里必须用 try_lock:若当前线程正持有日志锁(例如在写日志的过程中 panic),
// 再 lock() 就会自己把自己锁死 —— 那样连崩溃信息都留不下。
"[+?][{}][ERROR][panic][{tname}] 回溯(开发版带符号,release 版可能只有地址):\n{}",
/// 启动快照:把"跨设备排错真正需要的环境事实"一次性写进去。
/// 为什么值得单独一整块:几乎所有"我这里不行你那里行"的问题,
/// 答案都在这几行里 —— 发行版/内核、会话类型(Wayland 与 X11 的 grab 行为不同)、
/// 用户所属组(有没有 input 组)、配置文件在不在、显示器与缩放。
/// 启动快照文本(界面导出用)
/// 读取日志尾部若干字节(界面预览与导出用;不解析,原样返回)

/// 会话类型。Wayland 与 X11 对 evdev 抓取、光标隐藏的行为并不一致,
/// 很多"我这儿抓不到按键"的差异都出在这里。
/// 当前用户与所属组(是否在 input 组直接决定能否读 /dev/input)
"否 —— 读不到 /dev/input,必须 sudo usermod -aG input $USER 后重新登录"
/// gid -> 组名(查 /etc/group);查不到就退回数字
/// 显示器分辨率。多显示器与 DPI 缩放是 Windows 侧 FPS 出问题的头号嫌疑,
/// 所以这两个值要留在快照里。
// Linux/macOS 走 X11 或 Wayland,取值要额外接口且与注入无关(我们的坐标空间
// 以手机分辨率为准),这里只记环境变量给出的提示。
// 顺序很重要:Wayland 桌面上 DISPLAY 通常**也**有值(XWayland 兼容层),
// 先看 DISPLAY 会把所有 Wayland 会话都误报成 X11 —— 而这两者的
// 输入抓取行为并不相同,正是排查时要区分的。
/// 三个配置文件的在否与大小 —— 一眼看出"配置根本没被读"这类问题
/// 用系统时区而不是 UTC:诊断日志的价值有一大半在于和 `journalctl` /
/// Windows 事件查看器对齐时间线,而那两个工具显示的是本地时间。
let (y, mo, d, h, mi, s, _) = local_parts(secs);
/// 带毫秒的当前本地时间
let (y, mo, d, h, mi, s, ms) = local_parts(st.as_secs());
/// epoch 秒 -> 本地时间各分量 (年,月,日,时,分,秒,毫秒)
fn local_parts(secs: u64) -> (i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, u32) {
let t: libc::time_t = secs as libc::time_t;
let mut tm: libc::tm = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
// localtime_r 失败(极端时区库缺失)时退回纯 Rust 的 UTC 民用历算法,
// 宁可时间差几个时区,也不能让整行日志丢掉时间戳。
let (y, mo, d) = civil_from_days((secs as i64).div_euclid(86400));
return (y, mo, d, rem / 3600, (rem % 3600) / 60, rem % 60, ms);
fn local_parts(_secs: u64) -> (i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, i64, u32) {
let mut st: SYSTEMTIME = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
/// 自 epoch 起的天数 -> (年, 月, 日)(Howard Hinnant 民用历算法)。
/// 仅在 `localtime_r` 不可用时作为兜底。
let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
let m = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 };
(if m <= 2 { y + 1 } else { y }, m, d)
/// `error` 级一行:故障必须留下痕迹,且立即落盘
/// `warn` 级一行:可疑但不致命(丢事件、被拒绝、降级运行)
/// `info` 级一行:状态跃迁(连接/断开/开关映射/设备增减)
/// `debug` 级一行:排查时才需要的过程细节
/// `trace` 级一行:**只允许低频调用**。高频事件(鼠标位移等)必须先聚合成计数,
/// 否则 TRACE 级别会把引擎线程拖慢 —— 日志本身不能成为故障源。
/// 级别比较语义:`enabled` 是"不高于当前级别",即设 info 时 error/warn/info 都出
/// 级别名解析要容错常见写法(用户手写 settings.json 时不会那么规范)
/// 没有日志文件(或空文件)时不能误判成"上次异常结束" ——
/// 否则每次全新安装都会警告一次,狼来了之后用户就不看了
assert!(!previous_run_was_abnormal(&p), "文件不存在不应算异常");
assert!(!previous_run_was_abnormal(&p), "有退出标记不应算异常");
std::fs::write(&p, "[INFO] 跑到一半就被 kill 了").unwrap();
assert!(previous_run_was_abnormal(&p), "没有退出标记就算异常");

1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """把 `cargo clippy --all-targets` 的告警与基线比对（W2-5 / 审计方案的验证纪律之一）。
3: 
4: 用法::
5: 
6:     python ci/clippy_diff.py            # 只报告，永远退出 0（信息性）
7:     python ci/clippy_diff.py --strict   # 出现"新增/消失"即退出 1
8: 
9: 口径与《全面审计与提升方案-2026-10-05.md》里历次实施记录一致：
10: 
11: * 比对的是 **(文件, 消息文本) 去重集合**，不是行号 —— 行号每次重构都会动，
12:   消息文本才代表"同一类告警"；
13: * 基线文件 `ci/clippy-baseline.txt` 每行 `src/xxx.rs: warning: <消息>`，
14:   由维护者在"确认每一对都是既有构造"之后手工更新（更新时要在方案文档里记账）；
15: * 本机（Windows）的基线是 36 对；GitHub runner 上的 rustc 版本可能更新，
16:   因此 CI 把它当**信息性**步骤，不拦提交。
17: """
18: 
19: from __future__ import annotations
20: 
21: import io
22: import os
23: import re
24: import subprocess
25: import sys
26: 
27: HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
28: BASELINE = os.path.join(HERE, "clippy-baseline.txt")
29: BS = chr(92)  # 反斜杠
30: 
31: # Windows 控制台/重定向管道的默认编码是 GBK 或 cp1252，直接 print 中文会炸；
32: # 统一按 UTF-8 输出（本项目在 Windows + Linux 两边都跑这个脚本）。
33: sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
34: 
35: 
36: def load_baseline(path: str) -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
37:     pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
38:     with io.open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
39:         for line in fh:
40:             line = line.rstrip("\n")
41:             m = re.match(r"^(src[^:]+): warning: (.*)$", line)
42:             if m:
43:                 pairs.add((m.group(1).replace(BS, "/"), m.group(2).strip()))
44:     return pairs
45: 
46: 
47: def run_clippy() -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
48:     proc = subprocess.run(
49:         ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets"],
50:         capture_output=True,
51:         text=True,
52:         encoding="utf-8",
53:         errors="replace",
54:     )
55:     pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
56:     current = None
57:     for line in proc.stderr.splitlines():
58:         m = re.match(r"^warning: (.*)", line)
59:         if m and not line.startswith("warning: `scrcpy-pad`"):
60:             current = m.group(1).strip()
61:         m2 = re.match(r"^\s+--> (src[^:]+):\d+:\d+", line)
62:         if m2 and current:
63:             pairs.add((m2.group(1).replace(BS, "/"), current))
64:             current = None
65:     return pairs
66: 
67: 
68: def main() -> int:
69:     strict = "--strict" in sys.argv
70:     baseline = load_baseline(BASELINE)
71:     current = run_clippy()
72:     new = sorted(current - baseline)
73:     gone = sorted(baseline - current)
74: 
75:     print(f"当前告警对: {len(current)}   基线对: {len(baseline)}")
76:     print("--- 新增（当前有、基线没有）---")
77:     for f, msg in new:
78:         print(f"  {f} | {msg}")
79:     print("--- 消失（基线有、当前没有）---")
80:     for f, msg in gone:
81:         print(f"  {f} | {msg}")
82: 
83:     if new or gone:
84:         print("提示：确认每一对都是既有构造/已消除后，更新 ci/clippy-baseline.txt 并在方案文档里记账。")
85:         return 1 if strict else 0
86:     print("与基线零差异。")
87:     return 0
88: 
89: 
90: if __name__ == "__main__":
91:     raise SystemExit(main())

(End of file - total 91 lines)

与基线零差异。

4) 我没有验证到的部分(诚实列出)
- 非 Windows 的文件锁路径**只做了类型检查,没有真跑**:WSL(Ubuntu-24.04)里没有 rustc,本机 rustup 只有 linux 的 std、不能链接;那条"同锁文件第二次必须被拒"的单测是 `#[cfg(not(windows))]`,从未执行过。跨进程行为是用 Windows 互斥体那条测试真起子进程验证的。

需要你拍板的一件事:你之前建议别动 Cargo.toml、改用 pid 锁文件+OpenProcess 判活。我当时已经加了那一行 feature(现在全绿、测试也验证了)。**我的建议是保留互斥体**:它是内核对象,进程无论怎么死都不会留下陈旧锁,不需要"退出时记得删锁"这种约定;而你给的 create_new+pid+OpenProcess 方案里"判死→删→重建"之间有两个启动进程同时走到时的竞态(可能双双拿到锁),且要求所有退出路径删锁。如果你坚持不动 Cargo.toml,我建议改 `std::fs::File::try_lock`(零 feature、内核释放、无陈旧锁,我现有的跨进程测试可直接覆盖它),而不是 pid+OpenProcess。给我一句话,大约 10 分钟改完并重跑三道门。", "target": "lead"}

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.text:
The Lead approved keeping the mutex and asked for one doc addition: explicitly state in src/instance.rs's module docs that the non-Windows branch has not been actually run, only type-checked against x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.

But then they say "现在**停手不要改任何文件**,等我把你的 diff 过一遍 + 复跑门禁 + 打包。如果我发现问题会带着确切位置回来找你。"

Conflict: they asked for a doc note, then said stop touching files. Which takes precedence? They said "请在 ... 模块文档里明确写出 ... 免得以后有人以为它验过" and then "现在停手不要改任何文件". The "停手" is about not making further changes while they review the diff. If I now edit instance.rs, I invalidate their in-flight review and gate re-run — exactly what they don't want ("等我把你的 diff 过一遍 + 复跑门禁 + 打包").

The correct reading: they want the note added, but the immediate instruction is to freeze. The safest action: do NOT edit now (respect the freeze, avoid invalidating their verification), and ask/tell them: "这条注释我可以加,但它会让你的 diff review/门禁复跑作废——你说停手,所以我先不动;你打包/复核完回我一句,我立刻补上这 3 行注释并重跑三道门(改动仅注释,无行为变化)。或者你允许我现在就加(只需 1 分钟)。"

Hmm, but is that over-cautious? The note is a documentation-only change; adding it now means their diff review would include those 3 lines — they asked for it, so they'd expect it. But their "停手" came after, explicitly to let them review "你的 diff" — if I add lines now, what they review may differ from what they saw before. Since they asked for the note, having it in the reviewed diff is fine... but there's a real race: they may already be mid-review/have copied the diff.

Their instruction ordering: approval + ruling + request for the doc note + "现在停手不要改任何文件,等我把你的 diff 过一遍 + 复跑门禁 + 打包". I read the "停手" as the operative, most recent constraint, and the doc note as a follow-up request. The cost of waiting: the note lands after their review — meaning their reviewed diff lacks the requested note, and they'd need to trust a follow-up change... but a comment-only change can be verified by them at integration time; and the Lead said "如果我发现问题会带着确切位置回来找你" — so there will be another round anyway.

Hmm, but if I do nothing, will the note ever get added? If the Lead is about to package and finish, they might not come back → the requested doc note is missing → the Lead's explicit request unfulfilled. That's worse.

Middle path: reply immediately explaining the conflict and asking for a one-word decision, OR make the exact, minimal, comment-only edit now and report it precisely (with the diff of those lines) so their review can account for it.

Which does the Lead more likely want? They're a careful coordinator: they asked for the note *and* froze the tree. The freeze is likely about not doing *substantive* changes/flailing while they verify. A doc-comment addition that they themselves requested is not "改" in the risky sense... but they said "不要改任何文件". tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

Lead:你的 task-1 交付基本 OK,但有一个**测试设计缺陷**必须修,它会让门禁在用户正常使用程序时必然变红:

现象(我刚在共享工作区复跑):`cargo test --bin scrcpy-pad` → **303 passed / 1 FAILED**,失败的是
`instance::tests::another_process_holding_the_guard_is_detected`,panic 信息 =「守卫已被真实实例占用:跑单测前请先关掉正在运行的 scrcpy-pad」。

也就是说:只要用户**正开着程序**(现在就是),这个单测就必然失败 —— 这不是"发现了 bug",而是测试用了与生产**同一个锁名**。用户已经明确说过他经常只关 GUI、留着控制台,这会变成长期红灯。

请这样修(选一个,推荐第一个):
1. **把锁名做成可注入**:生产路径用 `Local\scrcpy-pad-single-instance-v1`,测试路径用带唯一后缀的名字(例如把测试进程 pid 或一个原子计数器拼进去),并在跨进程测试里让**子进程也拿到同一个测试用名字**(可通过环境变量把自己的锁名传给子进程,例如 `SCRCPY_PAD_INSTANCE_NAME`)。这样测试永远不与真实实例相撞。
2. 或者:检测到"被真实实例占用"时**跳过**该测试(打印一条 skip 提示,不算失败)—— 不如方案 1,因为它会把真正的回归也一起跳过,但比长期红灯好。

要求:修完重跑三道门(必须 **304 passed / 0 failed**,clippy 零差异),把原文和新 sha256(instance.rs)发我;改完**再次停手**。注意:当前工作区里有另一个队友(space-recheck)在改 src/app.rs 与 src/adb.rs,你**不要**碰这两个文件,也不要跑长时间占用 cargo 锁的命令太久。
